scope: Historical precursor build, not the Photon/worker-fixed packaged launcher
memory: sampled macOS physical footprint, decimal MB
limits: M5 macOS27, fresh processes with warm filesystem and private persistent Node module caches.
Node26.10.0 official npm entry enables compile cache; two warmups per policy/cohort excluded.
Node priority and Node stock controls are unbundled; published npm Node is the bundled shipping entry.
Priority Node has the same two Unicode/final-render source transforms, but bundling/bytecode/order differs.
Stable GC2 shares generic transforms/profile with native; stock-source stable retains original render code.
These are end-to-end application pipelines, not a JavaScript-engine-only microbenchmark.
Published npm Node is the primary shipping-pipeline comparison; unbundled Node controls explain source-transform and bundling differences.
Node compile caches are intentionally mutable and separately counted, not part of immutable source/runtime snapshots.
There is no same-executable native-off JIT row in this cohort; differences against Node/stable do not isolate AOT alone.
Deterministic local SSE/read-tool model excludes remote model/network latency and codemode during timing.
CPU is Pi-process all-thread user+system through visible idle; harness/mock/subprocess CPU excluded.
Peak memory is sampled macOS physical footprint in decimal MB, not Linux RSS.
Wall ends at final visible idle editor; later agent_settled processing is outside that endpoint.
Eight paired rounds per separate cohort; no outlier removal, historical cohort pooling or universal fastest claim.
